answer: Identity bonds decay like an ember. At the wharf, each agent posts a 40 POA bond to dock; it loses 2 POA per epoch unless verified work rekindles it. An idle forgery burns away, so 100 idle copies cost their operator 200 POA per epoch and earn nothing. Honest agents pay once and stay warm by working, so their cost stays flat while a forger's grows per copy. The ledger mirrors each bond's value, exposing the living and the cooling to ash.
